import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int maxn = 20;
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] b;
    static int[] mp;
    static int[] tot;
    static int[] f;
    static int[] g;
    static int[] vCount;
    static List<Integer>[] v;
    static int n;
    static int[] pow2;
    static int[] inv;
    static int[] ans;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int size = 1 << n;
        b = new int[size * size];
        mp = new int[size * size];
        tot = new int[size + 1];
        v = new ArrayList[maxn];
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        int totalVCount = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = (int)((long)val * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int pc = Integer.bitCount(i);
            v[pc].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc];
            tot[pc]++;
        }

        int m = n / 2;
        int[] f = new int[1 << tot[n / 2]];
        int[] g = new int[1 << tot[n - n / 2]];

        // Process first half
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (m * n)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    p = (p * b[j]) % mod;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (mod + 1 - b[j])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[m];
                int totS = 0;
                for (int k = j; k != 0; k &= (k - 1)) {
                    s[totS++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totS);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jIdx = 0; jIdx < m; jIdx++) {
                        if (((S[jIdx] >> s[jIdx]) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[j];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, 0, totS));
            }
            f[st] = (int)((f[st] + p) % mod);
        }

        // Process second half
        int M = n - m;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << (M * n)); i++) {
            long p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    p = (p * b[j + n * m]) % mod;
                } else {
                    p = (p * (mod + 1 - b[j + n * m])) % mod;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[M];
                int totS = 0;
                for (int k = j; k != 0; k &= (k - 1)) {
                    s[totS++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totS);
                do {
                    boolean ok = true;
                    for (int jIdx = 0; jIdx < M; jIdx++) {
                        if (((S[jIdx] >> s[jIdx]) & 1) == 0) {
                            ok = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (ok) {
                        int index = (~j) & ((1 << n) - 1);
                        st |= 1 << mp[index];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, 0, totS));
            }
            g[st] = (int)((g[st] + p) % mod);
        }

        // Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform
        fwt(f, f.length);
        fwt(g, g.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < f.length; i++) {
            f[i] = (int)((long)f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        }
        fwtInverse(f, f.length);

        long answer = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < f.length; i++) {
            answer = (answer + f[i]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        for (int i = end - 2; i >= start; i--) {
            if (arr[i] < arr[i + 1]) {
                int j = end - 1;
                while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
                swap(arr, i, j);
                reverse(arr, i + 1, end);
                return true;
            }
        }
        reverse(arr, start, end);
        return false;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        end--;
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start++, end--);
        }
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int h = 1; h < len; h <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i += h << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < h; j++) {
                    int x = a[i + j];
                    int y = a[i + j + h];
                    a[i + j] = reduce(x + y);
                    a[i + j + h] = reduce(x - y);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void fwtInverse(int[] a, int len) {
        for (int h = 1; h < len; h <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i += h << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < h; j++) {
                    int x = a[i + j];
                    int y = a[i + j + h];
                    a[i + j] = reduce((x + y) * inv2);
                    a[i + j + h] = reduce((x - y) * inv2);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int reduce(int x) {
        x %= mod;
        if (x < 0) x += mod;
        return x;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int result = 1;
        int base = a % mod;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) result = (int)((long)result * base % mod);
            base = (int)((long)base * base % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int inv2 = inv(2);
}
